nodes.label: JSREPORT_URL via host.docker.internal

nodes.rationale: TODO: should receive plan_ID and read price from PLAN table instead of trusting client amount.

nodes.norm_label: db tables plan, venta, detalle_venta, usuario, ubicacion_alerta

nodes.label: Single root .env configuration
nodes.rationale: One .env read by backend, Docker Compose and Vite; never prefix secrets with VITE_ since those ship to the browser.

nodes.label: Google Maps Platform (Maps JS + Geocoding)
nodes.rationale: Two separate keys (server IP-restricted for Geocoding, browser referrer-restricted for Maps JS) because they are restricted differently.

nodes.label: jsReport PDF reports
nodes.rationale: Templates designed in jsReport Studio without touching backend code; public endpoint only accepts stored template names, never client HTML.

nodes.label: PayPal Checkout flow (create order, approve, capture)
nodes.norm_label: paypal checkout flow (create order, approve, capture)

nodes.label: PayPal REST API (Orders v2)
nodes.rationale: PayPal does not support CLP; charge in USD. Backend creates/captures orders with secret.

nodes.label: Machine-dependent files not versioned (.graphify_python, .graphify_root)
nodes.rationale: Files contain absolute paths and interpreter paths specific to one machine.

nodes.label: Never commit secrets (.env, MySQL, PayPal, Twilio, Google Maps)
nodes.norm_label: never commit secrets (.env, mysql, paypal, twilio, google maps)

nodes.label: Unconfigured integration returns 503
nodes.rationale: Placeholder <INSERT_..._HERE> treated as empty so marker text is never sent to provider.

nodes.label: Branch Architecture (main, graphify, alonso, diego, gabriel)
nodes.norm_label: branch architecture (main, graphify, alonso, diego, gabriel)

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md graphify section and PreToolUse hook
nodes.norm_label: claude.md graphify section and pretooluse hook

nodes.label: graphify branch
nodes.rationale: Only branch where graphify-out/ is modified and committed; shared graph always represents main state.

nodes.label: Graphify (graphifyy 0.9.65)
nodes.rationale: Single pinned version for the whole team; mismatched versions invalidate the graph cache and cause huge diffs and conflicts.

nodes.label: Update and publish graph on graphify branch (6.4)
nodes.norm_label: update and publish graph on graphify branch (6.4)
nodes.rationale: Mandatory after every PR merged to main, done by the PR author the same day so updates are serialized.

nodes.label: main branch
nodes.rationale: Stable/production code; reached only via reviewed PR, never direct push or --force.

nodes.label: Team Workflow Guide (Claude Code + Graphify + Git)
nodes.norm_label: team workflow guide (claude code + graphify + git)

nodes.label: Merge, not rebase; no force push
nodes.norm_label: merge, not rebase; no force push

nodes.label: GRAPHIFY_SKIP_HOOK env variable
nodes.rationale: Disables automatic graph rebuild on git hooks so individual branches do not modify graphify-out/.

nodes.label: Individual developer branches (alonso, diego, gabriel)
nodes.rationale: Each developer writes only to their own branch; others' work arrives only through main after PR, never by direct merge between individual branches.
